explanation: Maintain the next unused element of each nonempty array in a min-heap. Removing the minimum and advancing only its source array produces the globally sorted sequence, preserving duplicates.
timeComplexity: O(k + N log(k + 1)) time for k arrays and N total entries, including the initial scan of empty arrays.
spaceComplexity: O(k) auxiliary heap space, plus O(N) output space.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
